verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a help-center index heading for 'Plugins and skills' covering installing, creating and publishing Kimi plugins and skills. It also lists one Feishu integration for Kimi Claw. Together these suggest add-on extensions can be installed, but there is no evidence of a browsable directory of third-party apps or connectors. missing for 10: evidence of a browsable third-party app/connector directory, documentation of how to add connectors to the assistant, breadth of available third-party connectors, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse a directory of third-party apps and connectors and add them to the assistant
